Based on a competitive learning algorithm that is originated from the coarse-fine competition, WINSTRON can identify the k larger elements or the k smaller ones in a data set. We will then prove that WINSTRON converges to the correct state in any situation. In addition, the convergence rates of WINSTRON for three special data distributions will be derived. In order to realize WINSTRON, its array architecture with low hardware complexity and high computing speed is also detailed.
